title: Code Quality Phases 2-4
description: The remaining technical-debt sweep after the widget-native-migration and widget-critical-fixes batches. Three priority tiers totalling ~10.5 hours of work: Phase 2 (HIGH, 6 fixes, ~4h) — performance/correctness bugs in repositories and cubits that ship to users; Phase 3 (MEDIUM, 11 fixes, ~4.5h) — code-smell and design-system hardening; Phase 4 (LOW, 11 fixes, ~2h) — lint-level cleanups, formatting, and documentation. Every fix targets a single file or a small fan-out of related files, keeps public APIs stable, and preserves the design-system rules captured in the widget-native-migration session context (tokens from lib/ui/core/tokens/, respect MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf, no hardcoded colors or numeric values where a token exists, no new packages).
parallel_strategy: All Phase 2 fixes except H2b and H4 are independent of each other and of every Phase 3 / Phase 4 fix; H2b depends on H2a (the new endpoint must exist before the cubit can call it); H4 must run AFTER H3 (H3 deletes RepositoryBase which H4's getAllAsync stub currently relies on). M1 (extract _extractUserMessage) is independent and can run in parallel with anything else — later fixes can adopt the new utility without a sequencing constraint because each fix touches its own file scope. All Phase 4 tasks are mechanical and independent. Phase ordering is recommended but not enforced — every individual subtask is self-contained enough to run in any order.
exit_criteria: BlockDetailsScreen._loadMembers fetches all member entities concurrently with Future.wait (or via an expand=member endpoint) — no more sequential for-loop awaits over N members

ICarnivalBlocksApiClient declares getByInviteCodeAsync(String inviteCode) AND ICarnivalBlocksRepository + CarnivalBlocksRepository + JoinBlockCubit call that endpoint instead of getAllAsync().where((b) => b.inviteCode == ...)

lib/data/repositories/base/repository_base.dart is deleted; CarnivalBlocksRepository and MeetingsRepository call IBaseApiClient methods directly via their typed API clients (no reflection, no RepositoryBase superclass)
MeetingPresencesRepository no longer implements getAllAsync by calling getByMeetingId(0); either implements a real list-all endpoint or throws UnimplementedError with a TODO comment

AuthRepository caches the result of _fetchTokenAndUuid() as a Future<String?>, not as the bare value, so concurrent callers of currentUuid share a single in-flight SharedPreferences read instead of racing
MeetingDetailsScreen listener uses listenWhen to fire the success snackbar exactly once per MarkingPresenceStatus transition (no replay when state object is recreated)
core/errors/user_message.dart exposes extractUserMessage(Object?) and JoinBlockCubit + MeetingDetailsCubit + any other cubit currently defining a private _extractUserMessage import it from there
AuthRepository._registerMember builds MemberCreate with profileImage: null (or omits the field) — no 'TODO' string literal reaches the API
lib/routing/router.dart no longer mounts the Routes.meetingPresences stub OR MeetingPresencesCubit is implemented to at least load presences for a meetingId path parameter
Every *.freezed.dart file has a matching @freezed-annotated source file in the same directory — no orphan generated files
AuthRepository no longer extends ChangeNotifier — a dedicated AuthListenable wrapper owns notifyListeners and is wired to GoRouter.refreshListenable in main_app.dart
_MeetingInfoCard.meeting is typed as MeetingsEntity, not dynamic
MemberCreate.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>) is the factory signature used by the generated _MemberCreateFromJson (not Object?)
AuthRepository.logout() returns Success(unit()) regardless of the underlying SharedPreferencesService result type, matching its IAuthRepository.logout(): AsyncResult<void> contract
AuthRepository.signUp() applies the same Failure(...) return path when either userIdResult OR tokenResult fails (no asymmetric cleanup that leaves the other persisted)
Every State.setState() / showDialog() call that follows an await is gated on `if (!mounted) return;`
No hardcoded EdgeInsets.all(NN), SizedBox(height: NN), or numeric padding/margin literals where a Spacing token exists in lib/ui/core/tokens/app_spacing.dart
`dart format --set-exit-if-changed lib/` produces no diff
No unused imports survive — verified via flutter analyze (which already flags these)
CachedNetworkImage call sites pass an explicit cacheKey that incorporates a version suffix (e.g. carnivalBlock.updatedAt) so profile-pic rotations invalidate the cache
CachedNetworkImage / FlutterCachedNetworkImage config sets a finite disk-cache maxAge (default cache_default_max_age = 7 days)
Every DateTime.parse() call inside lib/ (outside the .g.dart generated files) is wrapped in try { ... } on FormatException catch { ... } — return null or a sentinel value instead of crashing
Logger.root.level is set from kReleaseMode / kDebugMode in main.dart so release builds suppress INFO/SEVERE spam but debug builds keep full diagnostics
At least one new unit test exists in test/ exercising a pure function (extractUserMessage, isValidImageUrl, or a repository mapper)
integration_test dependency is either removed from pubspec.yaml or stubbed to a single placeholder test that passes `flutter test`
lib/ui/core/widgets/display/safe_network_image.dart wraps CachedNetworkImage + isValidImageUrl so callers cannot forget the guard
Every user-visible Portuguese string in lib/ui/ carries the correct diacritics (não, é, código, reunião, etc.) — verified via a grep that flags ' nao ', ' codigo ', ' reuniao ' in source strings
lib/data/services/api/meetingPresences/imeeting_presences_api_client.dart documents the isPresent=true|false semantics in dartdoc and the HTTP status codes it accepts

constraints.public_api_must_not_change: No constructor signature, no IRepositoryBase method shape, no MemberCreate factory shape may change in a way that breaks call sites that already exist
constraints.no_new_packages: All fixes use only existing dependencies (dio, result_dart, flutter_bloc, freezed_annotation, cached_network_image, logging)
constraints.no_existing_tests_to_update: Phase 2 / Phase 3 fixes do not need to update widget_test.dart (it only smoke-tests MainApp). Phase 4 L7 ADDS new tests; it does not modify existing ones.
constraints.tokens_from_lib/ui/core/tokens/: Where Phase 3 M11 / Phase 4 fixes introduce or touch spacing / radius / duration values, they MUST use the Spacing.* / Radii.* / AppDurations.* tokens. No bare numeric literals for spacing or radius.
constraints.respect_disable_animations: Where fixes touch animated widgets, MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) must still gate the animation
constraints.no_hardcoded_colors: No new hardcoded Color(0xFF...) or Colors.X constants — use ColorScheme or AppColors tokens
constraints.scope_discipline: Each subtask edits exactly the file(s) named in its reference_files. Do not refactor adjacent code, do not rename tokens, do not introduce new abstractions.
